title: Add Recipe CRUD Operations (Example)
description: Implement complete CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for recipe management. This includes database models, API endpoints, HTTP clients, and Blazor UI components. This is an EXAMPLE plan to demonstrate the harness workflow.

tasks.title: Add PostgreSQL database to AppHost
acceptance_criteria: PostgreSQL resource added to AppHost.cs using AddPostgres
Database named 'recipedb' created
ApiService references database with .WithReference(postgres).WaitFor(postgres)
EF Core PostgreSQL package added to ApiService project
AppHost starts successfully and Aspire Dashboard shows postgres container running

tasks.title: Create Recipe domain model and database context
acceptance_criteria: Recipe entity class created with properties: Id, Name, Description, Ingredients, Instructions, PrepTimeMinutes, CookTimeMinutes, Servings, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt
RecipeDbContext class created inheriting from DbContext
RecipeDbContext configured with Recipe entity in OnModelCreating
RecipeDbContext registered in ApiService Program.cs with AddNpgsqlDbContext
Initial migration created using dotnet ef migrations add
Migration applies successfully (database created with Recipes table)

tasks.title: Implement Recipe API endpoints with integration tests
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/recipes endpoint returns 200 with array of recipes
GET /api/recipes/{id} endpoint returns 200 with recipe or 404 if not found
POST /api/recipes endpoint creates recipe and returns 201 with location header
POST /api/recipes validates input and returns 400 for invalid data (empty name)
PUT /api/recipes/{id} endpoint updates recipe and returns 200 or 404
DELETE /api/recipes/{id} endpoint deletes recipe and returns 204 or 404
All endpoints have .WithName() and .WithOpenApi() calls
Integration tests created in RecipeManager.Tests/RecipeApiTests.cs
All integration tests pass (minimum 8 tests covering happy paths and error cases)

tasks.title: Create RecipeApiClient in Web project
acceptance_criteria: RecipeApiClient class created in RecipeManager.Web using primary constructor with HttpClient
GetRecipesAsync method returns Recipe[] from GET /api/recipes
GetRecipeAsync(int id) method returns Recipe? from GET /api/recipes/{id}
CreateRecipeAsync(Recipe recipe) method posts to /api/recipes and returns created Recipe
UpdateRecipeAsync(int id, Recipe recipe) method puts to /api/recipes/{id}
DeleteRecipeAsync(int id) method deletes from /api/recipes/{id}
All methods support CancellationToken and handle errors gracefully
RecipeApiClient registered in Web/Program.cs with AddHttpClient and service discovery URL
Unit tests verify client methods (optional for MVP)

tasks.title: Build Recipes list page
acceptance_criteria: Recipes.razor component created in RecipeManager.Web/Components/Pages/
Page accessible at /recipes route with @page directive
@attribute [StreamRendering(true)] added for streaming
@attribute [OutputCache(Duration = 10)] added for caching
RecipeApiClient injected and used to fetch recipes in OnInitializedAsync
Loading state displayed while fetching (if recipes == null)
Recipes displayed in grid or table format showing Name, Description, PrepTime, CookTime
Each recipe has View Details, Edit, and Delete buttons/links
Create New Recipe button/link at top of page
NavLink added to NavMenu.razor for /recipes route
Page renders successfully when app is run

tasks.title: Build Create Recipe form page
acceptance_criteria: CreateRecipe.razor component created at /recipes/create
EditForm component used with RecipeFormModel
Input fields for Name, Description, Ingredients, Instructions, PrepTime, CookTime, Servings
DataAnnotationsValidator and ValidationSummary included
ValidationMessage for each input field
Submit button calls HandleSubmit method
HandleSubmit creates Recipe via RecipeApiClient.CreateRecipeAsync
On success, navigates to /recipes using NavigationManager
On error, displays error message to user
Cancel button returns to /recipes
Form validation works (required fields, etc.)

tasks.title: Build Edit Recipe form page
acceptance_criteria: EditRecipe.razor component created at /recipes/{id:int}/edit
Loads existing recipe data on initialization using RecipeApiClient.GetRecipeAsync
Shows loading state while fetching recipe
Displays 404 or error message if recipe not found
Pre-populates form with existing recipe data
Uses same form structure as CreateRecipe
Submit updates recipe via RecipeApiClient.UpdateRecipeAsync
On success, navigates to recipe details or list
Cancel returns to previous page
Validation works same as create form

tasks.title: Build Recipe details view page
acceptance_criteria: RecipeDetails.razor component created at /recipes/{id:int}
Loads recipe data using RecipeApiClient.GetRecipeAsync
Displays all recipe fields: Name, Description, Ingredients, Instructions, times, servings
Shows formatted ingredients and instructions (line breaks preserved)
Edit button links to /recipes/{id}/edit
Delete button with confirmation dialog
Delete calls RecipeApiClient.DeleteRecipeAsync and navigates to /recipes
Back to List button returns to /recipes
Shows 404 page if recipe not found
Page renders correctly with sample data

dependencies: Docker Desktop must be running (for PostgreSQL container)
EF Core tools installed (dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef)
